purpose: Non-admission Dutch replacement-cost index and insurer method discovery for research-only building exposure valuation. Preserve separate entity grain and forbid conversion from cadastral, sale or address data into insured TIV without independent proof.

entries.name: Netherlands CBS new residential construction input-cost index 2021=100
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands aggregate; not a postcode or building-class price survey
entries.temporal_scope: Monthly provisional observations through September 2026; table metadata changed 2026-10-30
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2021=100 index, components total/labour/materials by month and year; dimensionless time escalation, no €/m² or €/m³ base price
entries.note: CBS 2026 September provisional total input-cost index is 129.5 (2021=100); it is NOT a reconstruction value or independently measured building-specific replacement cost. Revisions and different source-series definitions must be versioned. Do not use to uplift an insurer's 2026 table if that table already incorporates CBS escalation.

entries.name: Netherlands CBS new residential construction output-price index 2021=100
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands aggregate new housing, including contractor overhead/profit, excluding land and project developer or broker costs
entries.temporal_scope: Quarterly observations through provisional 2026 Q2; table metadata changed 2026-09-30
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 2021=100 index of new-residential-build construction output price incl/excl VAT, not physical house reconstruction amount
entries.note: 2026 Q2 provisional output price index is 133.4 (2021=100), not €/m² or €/m³. The output and input series are related signals, NOT independent price observations for an individual building and cannot be multiplied together. Their vintages and index bases must align before ratio-based escalation.

entries.name: AnsvarIdéa / Turien & Co Netherlands residential rebuilding-value meter 2026
entries.provider: AnsvarIdéa Verzekeringen / Turien & Co Assuradeuren; derivative of Verbond van Verzekeraars 2025 method
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands, conventional residential housing categories; atypical historic, monumental, luxury and very large houses explicitly excluded
entries.temporal_scope: 2026-01 edition, valid through 2027-01-31 according to document
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Residential reconstruction €/m³ typology guide with corrections for building attributes and volume, intended for insurer/insurance-adviser context; not BAG gross floor m² and not a binding insurance policy
entries.note: Private insurer/adviser 2026 method is based on 2025 Verbond van Verzekeraars meter and indexed using CBS inputs. It is NOT a continuing 2026 sector-wide Verband publication: sector association's central meter stopped in 2026. Its own 2026 prices must not be inflated again by the same cost-index period. Needs building external volume in m³, not a dwelling's BAG area in m² or a cadastral parcel area. Provider copyright/redistribution/commercial modelling terms not established. Do not embed price tables in public code, import raw insurer rates into CAT, or claim automatic reconstruction cost/TIV.
